FIELDS.NAME: Bloom & Blossom Cosmetics
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Rosewood Avenue, Suite 5678, Los Angeles, CA 90001-5678
FIELDS.GL CODE: Retail-only operations selling pre-packaged, branded cosmetics and toiletries with no on-site manufacturing (lower product liability exposure)
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Bloom & Blossom Cosmetics operates as a retail-only business specializing in pre-packaged, branded cosmetics and toiletries. We focus on providing high-quality products sourced exclusively from FDA-registered manufacturers, ensuring regulatory compliance and consumer safety. Our inventory includes a diverse range of cosmetics, skincare, and personal care products designed to meet the needs of our customers while minimizing contamination risks. With an annual sales figure under $500,000, we maintain a manageable operational scale and avoid the complexities that come with larger retail operations. Additionally, we implement robust inventory tracking and recall procedures to enhance our product safety measures, while prioritizing a customer-centered approach in our service delivery.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: "Bloom & Blossom Skincare, LLC, specializing in hypoallergenic skincare products, and Bloom & Blossom Fragrances, LLC, offering a range of branded perfumes."
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred during the month of March 2023 due to an accidental spill of product during a shipment, resulting in damages totaling $1,500. The claim is currently closed and has been resolved with no further actions required.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, Secure Locking Mechanism
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and onsite watchpersons for theft prevention.
